notes: Corrected the flagged four-morpheme unit: the article of kol ha-yamim asher was absorbed into as long as, but that rendering carries no determiner. Rule 30's dibrey ha-yamim ruling keeps a separately segmented article out of such a fusion, and rule 12 marks it unrepresented where the ASV writes no the.
The remaining three morphemes still fuse: no split gives kol an English word of its own, so as long as stays one noncompositional unit headed on yamim and on long.
whither fuses the relative with the resumptive shammah and its directive he under rule 22, which names that word; the unit is retained.
